N=10
# create variables
X = [[Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(N)] for i in range(N)]
s = Solver()
for i in range(N):
    for j in range(N):
        if vals[i*N+j] != -1:
            s.add(X[i][j] == vals[i*N+j])
        else:
            s.add(And(X[i][j]>=0, X[i][j]<=9))
    # row distinct
    s.add(Distinct(X[i]))
    # column distinct
    col = [X[r][i] for r in range(N)]
    s.add(Distinct(col))

    m=s.model()
    sol=[m.evaluate(X[i][j]).as_long() for i in range(N) for j in range(N)]
    print(sol)

    print('unsat')
